problem_description: Site work on kitchen fits waited over two weeks for toughened glass units after materials were ordered.
action_taken: Ordered known long-lead items the day the quote was accepted instead of at drawing sign-off.
outcome: The glass wait disappeared from the schedule; fitters stopped being stood down.

problem_description: Jobs stalled between materials ordering and site start because supplier lead times were guessed.
action_taken: Recorded actual lead times per supplier on the materials sheet and scheduled site work against them.
outcome: Start dates stopped slipping; clients got honest dates at quote stage.

problem_description: Spray-finished doors held up several jobs when the finishing shop got backed up.
action_taken: Booked spray-shop slots at order time and kept one backup finisher.
outcome: Finishing delays dropped, though the backup shop cost more per unit.

problem_description: A supplier's stock problem left three jobs waiting with no warning.
action_taken: Asked suppliers to confirm despatch dates within 48 hours of an order and flagged anything unconfirmed.
outcome: Stock problems surfaced the week the order was placed instead of the week the job was due.

problem_description: Common fixings ran out mid-job, pausing site work while someone drove to the merchant.
action_taken: Kept a buffer stock of hinges, runners and screws in the workshop, restocked monthly.
outcome: Merchant runs during site work stopped.

problem_description: Winter jobs waited on materials because orders were batched to save on delivery charges.
action_taken: Trialled batching only non-critical items while ordering critical-path materials immediately.
outcome: Abandoned after a month — the delivery savings were not worth the tracking overhead, and per-job ordering returned.

problem_description: Fitters drove back to site to re-measure because the first survey missed service positions.
action_taken: Used a fixed survey checklist covering openings, services and access on the first visit.
outcome: Re-measures fell from roughly one a fortnight to one a quarter.

problem_description: The workshop queried survey dimensions and triggered repeat site visits.
action_taken: Photographed every opening alongside its measurements and had the workshop confirm the cutting list from the survey pack before ordering.
outcome: The workshop stopped sending fitters back for missing dimensions.

problem_description: Stair jobs were re-measured because floor levels were assumed level on the first visit.
action_taken: Added a laser-level check to the survey kit for stair and wardrobe jobs.
outcome: Assumption-driven re-measures stopped on those job types.

problem_description: Re-measures happened when the quoting joiner and the fitting joiner surveyed differently.
action_taken: Standardised the survey form so any joiner's measurements read the same.
outcome: Handover between quoting and fitting stopped producing repeat visits.

problem_description: Big commercial jobs needed second visits because one surveyor could not cover everything.
action_taken: Sent two people on surveys over a set contract value.
outcome: Second visits reduced, but scheduling two people proved hard in busy months.

problem_description: Clients changed opening sizes after survey, forcing re-measures.
action_taken: Asked clients to sign the survey sheet as the agreed baseline, with changes quoted separately.
outcome: Changes still happened but were billed rather than absorbed.

problem_description: Fitters were called back for snagging after handover on nearly a third of fits.
action_taken: Walked the snag list with the client against the job spec before leaving site and fixed same-day items on the spot.
outcome: Call-backs dropped to the odd genuine defect.

problem_description: Snagging revisits went unbilled because defects were reported weeks after handover.
action_taken: Signed off the walk-through with the client so the invoice went out immediately and later reports were quoted as new work.
outcome: The invoice lag disappeared and free revisits stopped.

problem_description: Door alignment call-backs clustered in winter as timber moved after fitting.
action_taken: Let site-stored timber acclimatise for 48 hours before fitting in the wet months.
outcome: Winter alignment call-backs roughly halved.

problem_description: Revisits were wasted waiting on parts the fitter did not carry.
action_taken: Stocked each van with a standard snagging kit — hinges, runners, touch-up finish.
outcome: Most snags were fixed in one visit.

problem_description: The same fitting mistakes recurred across different fitters.
action_taken: Ran a monthly toolbox talk reviewing that month's snag list.
outcome: Repeat categories shrank, though new starters still generated a bump each time.

problem_description: Handover was skipped on small jobs, and small jobs generated the most call-backs.
action_taken: Made the client walk-through mandatory regardless of job size.
outcome: Small-job call-backs fell in line with the rest.

problem_description: Quotes sat unanswered for weeks with no follow-up.
action_taken: Diarised a follow-up call one week after every quote.
outcome: Win rate improved and dead quotes were closed off.

problem_description: Invoices were paid thirty-plus days late by two commercial clients.
action_taken: Added staged payments to commercial terms.
outcome: Cashflow gaps narrowed.

problem_description: A van breakdown pushed three site starts back a week.
action_taken: Booked van servicing in the quiet season and listed a hire firm as backup.
outcome: Breakdowns stopped cascading into the schedule.

problem_description: Material costs on quotes drifted as supplier prices rose.
action_taken: Refreshed the price list quarterly with each supplier.
outcome: Quote margins stopped eroding.

problem_description: Clients requested design changes after acceptance, mid-build.
action_taken: Introduced a change-order form priced before work continued.
outcome: Changes stopped stalling the workshop.

problem_description: Workshop racking made sheet materials slow to pull.
action_taken: Rebuilt racking by sheet size and labelled the bays.
outcome: Pulling materials for a job takes minutes.

problem_description: First-aid cover lapsed when the one certified member left.
action_taken: Trained two staff and diarised recertification.
outcome: Cover maintained.

problem_description: Dust extraction bags were changed mid-cut, interrupting the saw line.
action_taken: Moved bag changes to the morning routine.
outcome: Interruptions stopped.
